plugins.name: self-recording
plugins.description: Set up a Markdown folder as durable, portable AI memory that records itself while you work — project journals, provenance metadata, git-backed undo, and auto-commit hooks. Use when someone wants their notes or project folder to become memory an AI reads and writes across sessions and clients, wants to stop re-explaining context to every new chat, wants AI-written notes kept distinguishable from their own, or asks to replicate an "Obsidian as AI memory" / "AGENTS.md vault" setup. Also use to audit or repair an existing one.
